# UIGradient

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIGradient")`

Colours and fades its parent (ADR 0110): what the parent draws -- its background, its picture, its text -- is multiplied by `Color` and faded by `Transparency` along the gradient. Under a `UIStroke` it colours the stroke instead. Like `UICorner`, it changes the drawing and not the layout or the hit test; the first one under a parent is the one that counts.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Color` | `ColorSequence` | `ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))` | read/write | The colours along the gradient, multiplied into the parent's own. White changes nothing. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Off draws the parent as though it had no gradient. |
| `Offset` | `Vector2` | `Vector2.new(0, 0)` | read/write | Moves the gradient's centre by fractions of the parent's size: (1, 0) is a whole width to the right. Negative values are legal. |
| `Rotation` | `number` | `0` | read/write | Degrees, clockwise. A linear gradient at 0 runs left to right; a conical one starts pointing right. A radial gradient ignores it. |
| `Scale` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How much of the parent one run of the sequence spans: 1 is once across; 0.25 is a quarter, the rest filled per `TileMode`. For a radial gradient it scales the radius, for a conical one the sweep (never more than a turn). |
| `TileMode` | `Enum.GradientTileMode` | `Enum.GradientTileMode.Clamp` | read/write | What fills the space past the sequence's end when `Scale` is below 1 or `Offset` moves it: the end colours, the sequence again, or the sequence mirrored. |
| `Transparency` | `NumberSequence` | `NumberSequence.new(0)` | read/write | The see-through along the gradient: 0 leaves the parent as opaque as it was, 1 hides it. |
| `Type` | `Enum.GradientType` | `Enum.GradientType.Linear` | read/write | The gradient's shape: a line across the parent, a circle out from its centre, or a sweep round it. |
